top_signals.title: Swiss Biotech Windward Raises $225 Million in US IPO, Placement
top_signals.summary: Windward Bio Group AG, raised about $225 million in a US initial public offering that priced at the midpoint of its marketed range, along with a private placement.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cramer says Jensen Huang betrayed Nvidia shareholders. How to pick up the pieces
top_signals.summary: Without Huang, Cramer said Thursday, "There won't be a better Nvidia, just a different one."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Braskem Misses Estimates as Weaker Spreads Offset Sales
top_signals.summary: Braskem SA posted a larger-than—expected loss as petrochemical spreads narrowed amid a normalization of global supplies, outweighing stronger sales in Brazil.
